lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly as lines approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 7th vertical line from the anterior, with the split occurring in the upper 20% of the torso height near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st line (anterior) and 11th line (posterior) are abbreviated segments; the 7th and 9th lines show fragmentation/discontinuity near the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior flank and upper hind limb, concentrated in the lower-mid quadrant of the haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally, forming a semi-connected geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking across the bridge of the muzzle; white throat patch; white transverse bands (socks) located on the lower limbs above the hooves; dark pigmentation on the distal margins of the pinnae.
